code_improvements.title: Add Search to Categories Page
code_improvements.description: Add search functionality to the categories page, allowing users to filter categories by name. This mirrors the existing search pattern already implemented in the products page.
code_improvements.rationale: The products page at app/(dashboard)/products/page.tsx already has a working search input with searchQuery state and filtering logic. The categories page is missing this feature despite having the same UI component pattern. Direct pattern replication with minimal changes.
existing_patterns: Search input with state in products/page.tsx (lines 176, 435-443)
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Copy the searchQuery state and filtering logic from products/page.tsx. Add a Card section with search input above the categories list. Filter rootCategories by name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) before rendering.

code_improvements.title: Add Usage Limits Dashboard Component
code_improvements.description: Create a dashboard component showing organization usage limits (products, categories, tables) with progress bars. The getAllLimitStatuses() function already returns all limit data with usage percentages.
code_improvements.rationale: The lib/guards/limits.ts file has a fully implemented getAllLimitStatuses() function (lines 258-305) that returns currentCount, limit, usagePercent, and isUnlimited for each limit type. This data is ready but has no UI visualization. Similar stats card pattern exists in tables/page.tsx.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Add a 'Usage Limits' Card section in the settings page. Call getAllLimitStatuses(organization.id) on mount. Display each limit as a progress bar with currentCount/limit text. Show percentage and color-coded status (green <70%, yellow 70-90%, red >90%).

code_improvements.title: Add Price History Export Button
code_improvements.description: Add a button to export price change history for compliance reporting. The exportPriceLedgerForCompliance() function already exists and formats data for regulatory submission.
code_improvements.rationale: The lib/services/price-ledger.ts file has exportPriceLedgerForCompliance() function (lines 517-559) that generates properly formatted compliance data with date ranges. No UI triggers this function currently. The audit page already has date filtering and export paradigm.
existing_patterns: Download pattern from tables QR export
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Add an 'Export Price History' button in the audit page header next to the Refresh button. Add date range picker modal. Call exportPriceLedgerForCompliance() and trigger JSON/CSV download using the same blob download pattern from tables QR export.

code_improvements.title: Add Bulk QR Code Download for All Tables
code_improvements.description: Add functionality to download all table QR codes at once as a ZIP file or combined PDF, instead of downloading each table's QR individually.
code_improvements.rationale: The tables page already has individual QR download functionality (handleDownloadQR) with SVG/PNG/PDF formats. The QR generator functions already exist in lib/qrcode/generator.ts. Extending to bulk download follows the existing validateBulkAdd pattern in limits.ts for handling multiple items.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Add 'Download All QR Codes' button in page header. Create handleBulkDownloadQR that iterates through tables array, generates QR for each, and either: (a) uses JSZip library to create combined ZIP, or (b) generates multi-page PDF using existing PDF generator. Show loading progress indicator.

code_improvements.title: Add Menu Snapshot Version Comparison View
code_improvements.description: Add UI to compare two menu snapshot versions side-by-side, showing what products/categories were added or removed between publishes.
code_improvements.rationale: The lib/services/snapshot.ts already has compareSnapshots() function (lines 611-654) that returns addedProducts, removedProducts, addedCategories, removedCategories arrays. This comparison logic exists but has no UI. Similar diff-view pattern exists in the audit detail modal showing old_data vs new_data.
existing_patterns: Old/new data display in audit modal (lines 591-612)
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Add a 'Menu History' tab or page section. List snapshot versions using getSnapshotHistory(). Allow selecting two versions. Call compareSnapshots() and display results in a modal showing added items in green, removed items in red, using the same pre/code styling from audit detail modal.
